trigger_condition.note: D-014: GDPR Art.33's threshold is LOW - notify unless the breach is unlikely to result in risk. Even if encryption_key_acquired=false (patient_support/diagnosis data stays protected), the account_profile dataset (email+password_hash) is explicitly UNENCRYPTED per evidence-pack.md California facts and structurally identical across jurisdictions - unconditional credential exposure (phishing/credential-stuffing risk) is sufficient to clear this low bar on its own. Trigger therefore stays population>0, independent of encryption_key_acquired. Still a judgment call, not a certainty - flag in defense.
